title: An Unfamiliar Weight
quest_description: The token in your pack has not stopped humming since the regard settled on you. Marshal McBride says the kobolds skulking the Northshire valley have grown bolder of late, drawn — he suspects — to whatever the token answers. Thin them, and the watcher will see what you are made of.
objective_text: Cull Kobold Vermin in the Northshire valley.
offer_reward_text: The humming quiets, just a little. The regard has taken its measure of you.
request_items_text: The token still hums. There is more to be done.
